==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) Acid Jet piloting a Blood Bear Mech attacked us on a Paradise World. (Acid Jet is a villainous variant of me, who wants to reshape the Storyverse in his image. Acid Jet is the being that originally corrupted Celestial Dragon Jet on 09/13/2025. Celestial Dragon Jet was nearly killed by Acid Jet during the 09/25/2025 attack. This marks him as one of the biggest threats in the Storyverse over the last two weeks.) (Blood Bear is a villain that I first encountered on 07/30/2025. Blood Bear resembled a muscular humanoid purple bear with a large heart shaped scar on his chest. I haven't encountered him in a while, as I trapped him in a Pocket Universe on 07/31/2025. Blood Bear is a blood bending, humanoid bear. He isn't known for building machines. He was more focused on stealing riches and filling his belly. Blood Bear doesn't appear in this dream, but a mech of Blood Bear is a very odd thing to see Acid Jet piloting. It implies that there might be a connection between these two figures. This means that Acid Jet's influence might stretch even further back, depending on when he established any connection to Blood Bear.) I was able to defeat the mech with a divine binding spell. (The specific spell I used was a combination of two spells. I used the ""Ligo"" spell, which I first discovered creates links between targets in a dream on 06/23/2025. I also used the ""Aegis"" spell, which I first used on 07/04/2025 when battling a muscular Pink Were-Beagle. The Aegis spell acts as a divine and nearly unbreakable shield. By combining these two spells, I can create a nearly unbreakable binding to trap opponents. That's how I restrained Acid Jet's Blood Bear Mech.) Acid Jet tried to escape into the sand, but it dried out his liquid body.
